title: 克拉格赛德当晚编辑名单
instruction:
您是奥因·阿德博瓦莱 (Oyin Adebowale)，Tandem Ridge Sports Network 的精彩片段负责人，布林·科瓦连科 (Bryn Kovalenko) 需要在周一工作人员电话会议之前发布 Cragside 邀请赛编辑名单。使用提供的工作簿 `Cragside_edit_inputs.xlsx`（其中包含程序包列表、编辑器可用性、整理台可用性、字幕编码器窗口、工作人员协议限制、上行链路插槽和规定的时序假设）在您开始的工作目录的顶层创建 `Cragside_edit_roster.xlsx`。该工作手册涵盖三个比赛日，包括与阿什格罗夫合作社和坦纳里赛德供应相关的套餐。请让返回的工作簿可供精彩制作者和运营协调员使用，而不仅仅是提供无法解释的计算。 (1) 构建一个 `Roster` 表，显示每个范围内的包、其日期、编辑器、编辑开始和结束、根据需要完成开始和结束、字幕状态或窗口、上行链路插槽以及计划交付时间。 (2) 构建一个`Bay Plan` 表，使所有四个精加工区的占用情况随着时间的推移而可见，包括足够的信息来识别重叠和空闲期。 (3) 仅在提供的可用时间内安排所有 12 名编辑，不要指派一名编辑同时工作，并将每个包保持在提供的 10 小时周转要求内。
(4) 遵守所提供的用餐惩罚规则，并在计划中注明任何所需的用餐时间；不要默默地假设发生了中断。 (5) 仅在工作簿中提供的供应商配备的窗口中使用单字幕编码器，并且不要在同一编码器窗口中安排两个字幕作业。 (6) 将包放入提供的两个上行链路插槽中，当晚上的决赛运行时间较长时，应用工作簿的后期决赛假设，并显示在这种情况下哪些包移动或保持不受影响。 (7) 保持每天的包顺序一致，并使优先级、所有者、时间安排和后续步骤足够具体，以便工作人员在当晚的周转期间执行。 (8) 添加不超过 250 个单词的 `Method` 表，用于标识您使用的源范围，解释调度和后期计算，记录您如何处理任何源异常或不可用值，并说明您如何检查十小时、餐点、间隔、编码器、编辑器和上行链路约束。 (9) 添加`Change Log` 表，记录根据提供的输入进行的授权更改，包括分配、时间更改和任何排除，而不将无法解释的公式错误复制到结果中。请勿更改或覆盖提供的工作簿，请勿发明包、人员、容量或时间安排，也不要使用猜测值填充不受支持的字段。
在返回的工作簿中准确使用工作表名称 `Roster`、`Bay Plan`、`Method` 和 `Change Log`，保持源包标识符始终可追踪，并仅在工作目录顶层将完成的可交付成果保存为 `Cragside_edit_roster.xlsx`。

---

上面提到的文件在`references/`中：

- `references/Cragside_edit_inputs.xlsx` — 提供权威的软件包清单、三天的活动时间、编辑器可用性、整理台可用性、字幕编码器窗口、工作人员协议规则、上行链路槽、后期最终假设以及构建名册和台计划所需的源注释。

将您完成的工作写入**当前工作目录的顶层**，使用以下文件名：

- `Cragside_edit_roster.xlsx` — 可执行的三天连夜编辑名册和整理区计划，包含方法和变更文档。 （保存在起始工作目录的顶层。；准确使用工作表名册、间隔计划、方法和更改日志。；不要发明不受支持的源事实或覆盖提供的源工作簿。；方法不得超过 250 个字。）

除了这些文件名之外，不会收集任何内容。在其他地方或以任何其他名称编写的正确文件得分为零。

sheets.name: Method
rows:
Located authoritative package headers at Inputs!D6:R22 beneath the banner and gutter; resource tables are Inputs!D27:H63 (editors), D69:F80 (bays), D84:H89 (encoder), D93:E99 (rules), and D103:H108 (uplinks). Notes take precedence over ordinary columns: finals use a 19:00 late release and move Slot A to Slot B; D2-X99 is excluded as a duplicate; caption-window notes are retained. The residual formula error was ignored and not copied.

Edit starts respect release times and exact source durations; finishing follows edit completion. Caption reservations are 10-minute blocks inside vendor windows. Delivery is after the chain and within ten hours of effective release; late-final delivery is 23:20. Meal rule is a 30-minute break when an editor span exceeds six hours, shown on affected rows. I checked editor overlap/availability, bay overlap/availability, single-encoder overlap/window, meal placement, turnaround, dependency order, and uplink capacity/slot timing for baseline and late-final scenario.

criteria.description: 返回的工作簿是一个可读的 XLSX 文件。
criteria.evidence: 工作簿打开并显示可读的单元格内容。
criteria.grader_hint: 使用脱机电子表格库打开并确认文件未损坏。

original.criterion: The returned workbook is a readable XLSX file.
original.evidence: Workbook opens and exposes readable cell contents.
original.grader_hint: Open with an offline spreadsheet library and confirm the file is not corrupt.

criteria.description: 该工作簿包含工作表名册、湾计划、方法和更改日志。
criteria.evidence: 工作簿工作表名称列表。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查工作簿工作表名称；奖励仅适用于确切的四名套装。

original.criterion: The workbook contains exactly the sheets Roster, Bay Plan, Method, and Change Log.
original.evidence: Workbook sheet-name list.
original.grader_hint: Inspect the workbook sheet names; award only for the exact four-name set.

criteria.description: 名册覆盖范围等于应用源 Notes 覆盖后设置的范围内包，不遗漏任何范围内包。
criteria.evidence: 名册包标识符与源包标识符进行比较。
criteria.grader_hint: 根据权威源字段和注释重新计算范围，然后比较标识符集。

original.criterion: Roster coverage equals the in-scope package set after applying source Notes overrides, with no in-scope package omitted.
original.evidence: Roster package identifiers compared with source package identifiers.
original.grader_hint: Recompute scope from the authoritative source fields and Notes, then compare identifier sets.

criteria.description: 没有被适用的 Notes 例外排除的包显示为计划工作。
criteria.evidence: 来源注释和名册标识符。
criteria.grader_hint: 根据名册和更改日志检查每个排除注释。

original.criterion: No package excluded by an applicable Notes exception appears as scheduled work.
original.evidence: Source Notes and Roster identifiers.
original.grader_hint: Check each exclusion note against the Roster and Change Log.

criteria.description: 每个名册包都保留其权威源标识符，并且可以追溯到源行。
criteria.evidence: 名册标识符和来源参考字段。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认每个输出标识符存在于已解析的源表中，并且在源将其定义为唯一的情况下是唯一的。

original.criterion: Every roster package retains its authoritative source identifier and can be traced to the source row.
original.evidence: Roster identifiers and source reference fields.
original.grader_hint: Confirm each output identifier exists in the parsed source table and is unique where the source defines it as unique.

criteria.description: 每个包裹都被分配到其权威活动日。
criteria.evidence: 名册日和来源日。
criteria.grader_hint: 应用任何注释覆盖后比较日期值。

original.criterion: Each package is assigned to its authoritative event day.
original.evidence: Roster day and source day.
original.grader_hint: Compare day values after applying any Notes override.

criteria.description: 每个编辑间隔的正持续时间等于源持续时间或记录的注释覆盖。
criteria.evidence: 名册编辑开始、编辑完成和源持续时间。
criteria.grader_hint: 计算结束减去开始并与有效持续时间进行比较。

original.criterion: Each edit interval has positive duration equal to the source duration or documented Notes override.
original.evidence: Roster edit start, edit finish, and source duration.
original.grader_hint: Compute finish minus start and compare to the effective duration.

criteria.description: 当需要完成时，每个完成间隔具有等于有效源完成持续时间的正持续时间。
criteria.evidence: 名册整理间隔和来源要求。
criteria.grader_hint: 仅检查需要精加工的包装并比较间隔长度。

original.criterion: Each finishing interval has positive duration equal to the effective source finishing duration when finishing is required.
original.evidence: Roster finishing interval and source requirements.
original.grader_hint: Check only packages requiring finishing and compare interval lengths.

criteria.description: 每个包的编辑开始时间不得早于其适用的源发布或事件时间。
criteria.evidence: 花名册中编辑开始时间和有效源时间的时序。
criteria.grader_hint: 在比较时间戳之前，应用“备注”中的时间覆盖规则。

original.criterion: Every package's edit begins no earlier than its applicable source release or event time.
original.evidence: Roster edit start and effective source timing.
original.grader_hint: Apply Notes timing overrides before comparing timestamps.

criteria.description: 每个包的计划交付时间不得晚于其有效源时间加上十小时。
criteria.evidence: 花名册中的交付时间与源事件/最终时间。
criteria.grader_hint: 使用有效源开始时间计算经过的小时数，且不得超过 10.0 小时。

original.criterion: Each package's planned delivery is no later than its effective source time plus ten hours.
original.evidence: Roster delivery time and source event/final time.
original.grader_hint: Calculate elapsed hours using the effective source start and allow no more than 10.0 hours.

criteria.description: 计划交付时间不得早于该包的编辑、精加工及所需字幕制作链的完成时间。
criteria.evidence: 花名册中的阶段时间戳。
criteria.grader_hint: 验证交付时间是否等于或晚于所有适用前置任务的最晚完成时间。

original.criterion: Planned delivery is not earlier than completion of the package's edit, finishing, and required captioning chain.
original.evidence: Roster stage timestamps.
original.grader_hint: Verify delivery is at or after the maximum applicable predecessor finish.

criteria.description: 没有剪辑师被分配到重叠的工作时间段。
criteria.evidence: 花名册中的剪辑师及其编辑时间段。
criteria.grader_hint: 按剪辑师分组并测试两两时间段的重叠情况，包括已记录的休息时间。

original.criterion: No editor is assigned to overlapping work intervals.
original.evidence: Roster editor and edit intervals.
original.grader_hint: Group by editor and test pairwise interval overlap, including documented breaks.

criteria.description: 每位指定剪辑师的工作均在其提供的可用时间内。
criteria.evidence: 花名册分配与源可用时间。
criteria.grader_hint: 将每个编辑时间段与有效可用时间窗口进行比较。

original.criterion: Every assigned editor's work falls within that editor's supplied availability.
original.evidence: Roster assignments and source availability.
original.grader_hint: Compare each edit interval with the effective availability window.

criteria.description: 没有任何精加工工位存在重叠的预约。
criteria.evidence: 工位计划中的预约。
criteria.grader_hint: 按工位分组并测试时间段重叠。

original.criterion: No finishing bay has overlapping reservations.
original.evidence: Bay Plan reservations.
original.grader_hint: Group by bay and test interval overlap.

criteria.description: 每项精加工预约均在所分配工位的可用时间内。
criteria.evidence: 工位计划与源工位可用时间。
criteria.grader_hint: 将每项预约与适用的工位时间窗口进行比较。

original.criterion: Every finishing reservation falls within the assigned bay's availability.
original.evidence: Bay Plan and source bay availability.
original.grader_hint: Compare each reservation against the applicable bay window.

criteria.description: 当源计划要求使用时，四个工位均有体现，且每项预约都与一个包相关联。
criteria.evidence: 工位计划中的工位和包列。
criteria.grader_hint: 将使用的工位标识符与源容量及所需预约进行比较。

original.criterion: All four bays are represented when the source plan requires their use, with each reservation tied to a package.
original.evidence: Bay Plan bay and package columns.
original.grader_hint: Compare used bay identifiers with the source capacity and required reservations.

criteria.description: 没有两个需要字幕的包在同一时间使用唯一的编码器。
criteria.evidence: 花名册中的字幕时间窗口。
criteria.grader_hint: 筛选出需要字幕的包并测试编码器时间段的重叠。

original.criterion: No two caption-required packages use the single encoder at the same time.
original.evidence: Roster caption windows.
original.grader_hint: Filter caption-required packages and test encoder interval overlap.

criteria.description: 每个字幕制作时间段完全位于供应商配备人员的编码器时间窗口内。
criteria.evidence: 花名册中的字幕时间窗口与源编码器时间窗口。
criteria.grader_hint: 将每个字幕时间段与有效的供应商时间窗口进行比较。

original.criterion: Every captioning interval is wholly inside a vendor-staffed encoder window.
original.evidence: Roster caption windows and source encoder windows.
original.grader_hint: Compare each caption interval with the effective vendor window.

criteria.description: 不需要字幕的包未被分配虚构的编码器预约。
criteria.evidence: 花名册中的字幕状态与源需求。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查非字幕包以确保编码器字段为空或不适用。

original.criterion: Packages not requiring captions are not assigned a fabricated encoder reservation.
original.evidence: Roster caption status and source requirement.
original.grader_hint: Check non-caption packages for blank or not-applicable encoder fields.

criteria.description: 每个必需的用餐休息均已明确体现，并落在适用的团队协议时间窗口内。
criteria.evidence: 花名册中的休息字段与源团队规则。
criteria.grader_hint: 根据每位剪辑师的排班跨度重新计算休息需求，并检查可见的休息时间段。

original.criterion: Every required meal break is explicitly represented and falls within the applicable crew-agreement window.
original.evidence: Roster break fields and source crew rule.
original.grader_hint: Recompute break need from each editor's scheduled span and inspect visible break intervals.

criteria.description: 没有用餐休息被表示为与该剪辑师指定的工作重叠。
criteria.evidence: 花名册中的工作与休息时间段。
criteria.grader_hint: 将每位剪辑师的休息时间段与其所有指定工作进行测试。

original.criterion: No meal break is represented as overlapping that editor's assigned work.
original.evidence: Roster work and break intervals.
original.grader_hint: Test each editor's break interval against all assigned work.

criteria.description: 每个包要么被分配到两个提供的上行链路时段之一，要么在有源支持的情况下明确标记为不需要上行链路。
criteria.evidence: 花名册中的上行链路字段与源需求。
criteria.grader_hint: 将上行链路分配与源包需求及时段列表进行比较。

original.criterion: Every package is assigned to one of the two supplied uplink slots or is explicitly marked as not requiring uplink with source support.
original.evidence: Roster uplink field and source requirements.
original.grader_hint: Compare uplink assignments with the source package requirements and slot list.

criteria.description: 任何上行链路时段均未包含重叠或超容量的包分配。
criteria.evidence: 花名册中的上行链路时段及交付时间。
criteria.grader_hint: 按时段分组并应用提供的时段容量及时序规则。

original.criterion: No uplink slot contains overlapping or over-capacity package assignments.
original.evidence: Roster uplink slot and delivery times.
original.grader_hint: Group by slot and apply the supplied slot capacity and timing rule.

criteria.description: “延迟最终版”场景应用于所有受影响的晚间最终版及其依赖包的时序。
criteria.evidence: 花名册和方法文档中的场景列或已记录的场景章节。
criteria.grader_hint: 根据提供的“延迟最终版”假设重新计算受影响的时间并比较输出结果。

original.criterion: The late-final scenario is applied to every affected evening final and its dependent package timing.
original.evidence: Scenario columns or documented scenario section in Roster and Method.
original.grader_hint: Recalculate affected times from the supplied late-final assumption and compare output.

criteria.description: 场景计划显示了受影响包所需的上行链路移动，且在没有支持的情况下未移动未受影响的包。
criteria.evidence: 花名册中的场景字段与源场景映射。
criteria.grader_hint: 将基线和“延迟最终版”时段分配与源依赖关系进行比较。

original.criterion: The scenario plan shows the required uplink movement for affected packages and does not move unaffected packages without support.
original.evidence: Roster scenario fields and source scenario mapping.
original.grader_hint: Compare baseline and late-final slot assignments against the source dependency relationships.

criteria.description: 场景计划仍满足剪辑师不重叠及可用时间约束。
criteria.evidence: 场景花名册时间段。
criteria.grader_hint: 对场景时间表运行相同的剪辑师重叠及可用时间检查。

original.criterion: The scenario plan still satisfies editor non-overlap and availability constraints.
original.evidence: Scenario roster intervals.
original.grader_hint: Run the same editor overlap and availability checks on the scenario schedule.

criteria.description: 场景计划仍满足精加工工位不重叠及可用时间约束。
criteria.evidence: 场景工位计划时间段。
criteria.grader_hint: 对场景计划运行工位重叠及可用时间检查。

original.criterion: The scenario plan still satisfies finishing-bay non-overlap and availability constraints.
original.evidence: Scenario Bay Plan intervals.
original.grader_hint: Run bay overlap and availability checks on the scenario plan.

criteria.description: 场景计划仍满足字幕编码器容量及供应商时间窗口约束。
criteria.evidence: 场景字幕预约。
criteria.grader_hint: 对场景计划运行编码器重叠及时间窗口检查。

original.criterion: The scenario plan still satisfies caption-encoder capacity and vendor-window constraints.
original.evidence: Scenario caption reservations.
original.grader_hint: Run encoder overlap and window checks on the scenario plan.

criteria.description: 场景计划为每个受影响的包保留了十小时的周转要求。
criteria.evidence: 场景交付时间及有效源时间。
criteria.grader_hint: 重新计算所有受影响包的经过小时数。

original.criterion: The scenario plan preserves the ten-hour turnaround requirement for every affected package.
original.evidence: Scenario delivery and effective source times.
original.grader_hint: Recompute elapsed hours for all affected packages.

criteria.description: 花名册中的编辑和精加工顺序尊重包依赖关系，且从未显示精加工在编辑完成之前。
criteria.evidence: 花名册中的阶段时间戳。
criteria.grader_hint: 根据源需求检查每个包的依赖链。

original.criterion: Roster edit and finishing sequences respect package dependencies and never show finishing before edit completion.
original.evidence: Roster stage timestamps.
original.grader_hint: Check each package's dependency chain from source requirements.

criteria.description: 所有源要求的精加工工作在每个包中仅体现一次。
criteria.evidence: 源精加工标志以及花名册/工位计划中的包标识符。
criteria.grader_hint: 将所需精加工的包集合与工位预约进行比较。

original.criterion: All source-required finishing work is represented exactly once per package.
original.evidence: Source finishing flags and Roster/Bay Plan package identifiers.
original.grader_hint: Compare required finishing package set with bay reservations.

criteria.description: 每个“备注”覆盖项的有效值在花名册中得到体现，或被记录为有意排除。
criteria.evidence: 源“备注”、花名册及变更日志。
criteria.grader_hint: 查看每个非空 Notes 单元格并追踪其效果。

original.criterion: The effective value of every Notes override is reflected in the roster or documented as an intentional exclusion.
original.evidence: Source Notes, Roster, and Change Log.
original.grader_hint: Review each nonempty Notes cell and trace its effect.

criteria.description: 残余源公式错误不会传播到任何返回的工作表中。
criteria.evidence: 返回的工作簿单元格值和公式。
criteria.grader_hint: 在所有返回的工作表中搜索#REF！以及对有缺陷的源单元的引用。

original.criterion: The residual source formula error is not propagated into any returned sheet.
original.evidence: Returned workbook cell values and formulas.
original.grader_hint: Search all returned sheets for #REF! and references to the defective source cell.

criteria.description: 返回的工作簿不包含 #REF!、#DIV/0! 或 #VALUE!代币。
criteria.evidence: 提供的工作簿中的所有单元格值和公式。
criteria.grader_hint: 搜索文本和公式表示时不区分大小写。

original.evidence: All cell values and formulas in the delivered workbook.

spec.professional_context: You are Oyin Adebowale, the highlights unit lead at Tandem Ridge Sports Network. Operations manager Bryn Kovalenko needs a publishable edit roster and finishing-bay plan before the Cragside Invitational crew call on Monday, covering work involving Ashgrove Cooperative and Tanneryside Provisions.
difficulty_sources: A multi-stage scheduling transformation must turn supplied package, crew, bay, encoder, meal, turnaround, and uplink data into a feasible three-day plan.
The source workbook contains a non-table banner and gutter columns that require locating the actual tables.
Per-row notes contain exceptions that override ordinary source fields.
A residual formula error must be ignored rather than propagated.
The roster must remain feasible under the supplied late-final timing scenario.

semantic_content: Create one workbook containing authoritative tables for packages across three event days, including package identifiers, source event or final times, edit durations, finishing durations, captioning requirements, priority, delivery target, and any supplied scenario marker.

Include twelve named editors with availability windows and permitted work information, four finishing bays with availability windows, one caption encoder with vendor-staffed windows, crew-agreement parameters for ten-hour turnaround and meal penalties, and two uplink slots.
Include a deterministic late-final scenario in which specified evening finals extend and the affected uplink timing slides according to the supplied assumption.
Include enough package and resource demand that local-looking assignments can become infeasible when all chains are pushed toward the end of day.
layout: Place a readable banner block above the main source tables and one or more gutter columns before the real table region, so the authoritative table does not begin at A1.
Keep all ordinary source values internally consistent and text-extractable.
seeded_defects_exactly: Leave one residual formula-error cell from a previous analyst containing #REF! in a non-authoritative helper or residual area. It must not be needed to derive any authoritative input and must be ignored rather than propagated.

Add a Notes free-text column to the package or assignment source table. Put per-row exceptions in notes that override the corresponding ordinary columns, including at least one timing or resource exception and at least one scope or handling exception.

Use the banner block and gutter columns as the only layout defects. Do not add blank-header defects, merged-cell ambiguity, malformed dates, duplicate records, inconsistent labels, hidden sheets, or other standard data-quality defects.

derivation_rules: The authoritative package set is determined from the source scope/status fields after applying row-level Notes overrides; excluded rows must not appear as scheduled packages.
A package's edit, finishing, captioning, and delivery chain is derived from its source event timing, durations, priority, resource requirements, and any applicable Notes override.
Every editor assignment must fit availability and prevent overlapping work; every finishing assignment must fit bay availability and prevent bay overlap.
The caption encoder has capacity one and may be used only within vendor-staffed windows; caption-required packages need a feasible encoder reservation.
Turnaround is measured from the applicable source event/final time to planned delivery and must meet the supplied ten-hour limit.
Meal compliance is evaluated against the supplied crew-agreement threshold and break rule; any required break must be represented in the returned plan.

Uplink assignment uses the two supplied slots. Under the late-final scenario, the affected final and dependent package times shift according to the source assumption, and the plan must still show a feasible slot or clearly identify the resulting rescheduled package.
The Method sheet must disclose source-table discovery, Notes overrides, treatment of the residual #REF! cell, any unsupported or unavailable field, and the checks used.
The Change Log should describe only changes made by the planner: assignments, timing, exclusions, scenario movements, and documented exceptions.
authoring_plan.gold_derivation: Use an offline reference script to parse the actual table region rather than assuming A1, apply Notes overrides, ignore the residual error cell, construct the package dependency chains, and verify resource occupancy and all hard constraints. Generate the reference roster from the supplied deterministic rules and retain relational checks for package coverage, timing, resource capacity, scenario movement, and traceability.

original_instruction:
You are Oyin Adebowale, the highlights unit lead at Tandem Ridge Sports Network, and Bryn Kovalenko needs the Cragside Invitational edit roster posted before the crew call Monday. Use the supplied workbook `Cragside_edit_inputs.xlsx`, which contains the package slate, editor availability, finishing-bay availability, caption-encoder windows, crew-agreement limits, uplink slots, and the stated timing assumptions, to create `Cragside_edit_roster.xlsx` in the top level of the working directory where you start. The workbook covers three competition days and includes packages connected with Ashgrove Cooperative and Tanneryside Provisions. Please make the returned workbook usable by a highlights producer and an operations coordinator rather than just presenting an unexplained calculation. (1) Build a `Roster` sheet showing every in-scope package, its day, editor, edit start and finish, finishing start and finish where required, captioning status or window, uplink slot, and planned delivery time. (2) Build a `Bay Plan` sheet that makes occupancy of all four finishing bays visible over time, including enough information to identify overlaps and idle periods. (3) Schedule all twelve editors only within their supplied availability, do not assign one editor to simultaneous work, and keep every package within the supplied ten-hour turnaround requirement. (4) Respect the supplied meal-penalty rule and make any required meal break visible in the plan; do not silently assume that a break occurred. (5) Use the single caption encoder only in the vendor-staffed windows supplied in the workbook, and do not schedule two captioning jobs in the same encoder window. (6) Place packages into the two supplied uplink slots, applying the workbook's late-final assumption when an evening final runs long, and show which packages move or remain unaffected under that scenario. (7) Keep the package sequence coherent across each day and make priorities, owners, timing, and next steps concrete enough for the crew to execute during a same-night turnaround. (8) Add a `Method` sheet of no more than 250 words that identifies the source ranges you used, explains the scheduling and late-final calculations, records how you treated any source exception or unavailable value, and states how you checked the ten-hour, meal, bay, encoder, editor, and uplink constraints. (9) Add a `Change Log` sheet recording the authorized changes made from the supplied inputs, including assignments, timing changes, and any exclusions, without copying an unexplained formula error into the result. Do not alter or overwrite the supplied workbook, do not invent packages, people, capacities, or timings, and do not fill an unsupported field with a guessed value. Use exactly the sheet names `Roster`, `Bay Plan`, `Method`, and `Change Log` in the returned workbook, keep the source package identifiers traceable throughout, and save only the finished deliverable as `Cragside_edit_roster.xlsx` at the working-directory top level.

---

The files referred to above are in `references/`:

- `references/Cragside_edit_inputs.xlsx` — Provides the authoritative package slate, three-day event timing, editor availability, finishing-bay availability, caption-encoder windows, crew-agreement rules, uplink slots, late-final assumptions, and source notes needed to construct the roster and bay plan.

Write your finished work to the **top level of the current working directory**, using exactly these filenames:

- `Cragside_edit_roster.xlsx` — An executable three-day same-night edit roster and finishing-bay plan with method and change documentation. (Save at the top level of the starting working directory.; Use exactly the sheets Roster, Bay Plan, Method, and Change Log.; Do not invent unsupported source facts or overwrite the supplied source workbook.; Method must be no more than 250 words.)

Nothing outside those filenames is collected. A correct file written anywhere else, or under any other name, scores zero.
